name: Malazan Book of the Fallen
overview: The Malazan Book of the Fallen is a sprawling, 10-book epic military fantasy series by Canadian author Steven Erikson. Praised for its immense scope and uncompromising depth, it blends myth-making, philosophy, and brutal warfare, following the struggles of ordinary soldiers, gods, and ancient beings against a backdrop of sweeping civilizational change.
